title: Reduction in Hawker Stall Rent for Hawkers who Fall Ill
what_it_is: Reduction in Hawker Stall Rent for Hawkers who Fall Ill

sections.label: Hawker stall rent and concessions
sections.summary: Stallholders in NEA-managed hawker centres must pay rent, but the Ministry may grant case-by-case assistance and exceptional rent waivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: All stallholders in NEA-managed hawker centres are required to pay rent throughout their tenancy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, my Ministry will consider requests from hawkers who are genuinely unable to carry on their business temporarily and explore options to assist them on a case-by-case basis.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, a stallholder who is ill may appoint a person to operate the stall on his or her behalf for the period he or she is ill.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: That said, when no other options are available, we do, from time to time, grant concessions where the circumstances are exceptional and worthy of compassion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For example, we have waived rent payments in a case where the stallholder was temporarily unable to operate his stall after he sustained serious injuries and had to undergo extensive medical treatment for a few months.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Ultimately, stallholders need to assess their own health and determine whether they are able or suited to work in the hawker trade.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Those who are often medically unfit to work in the hawker trade may wish to transfer their stalls to their relatives and consider other employment options.
